new_promo = 'AZc5b'

cart_after_new = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
print('cart_after_new', cart_after_new)
new_total = cart_after_new.get('total_cost')
new_valid = cart_after_new.get('promo_valid')
print('new_total', new_total, 'new_valid', new_valid, 'promo_code_now', cart_after_new.get('promo_code'))

# Decide which promo is cheaper; restore old promo if needed
if new_valid and (old_total is not None) and new_total is not None and new_total > old_total:
    # old is cheaper -> re-apply old promo code
    restore = apis.amazon.apply_promo_code_to_cart(promo_code=old_promo, access_token=amazon_token)

    cart_after_restore = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)

    chosen_total = cart_after_restore.get('total_cost')
    chosen_promo = cart_after_restore.get('promo_code')

def is_valid(card):
    y = int(card.get('expiry_year'))
    m = int(card.get('expiry_month'))

    if y < 100:

    return (y > cur_year) or (y == cur_year and m >= cur_month)
